Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in Step 3 by misinterpreting the title "Dilan 1991" as the actual release year of the film. The WebSurfer correctly identified in Step 2 that the film was released in 2019 (based on IMDb and Wikipedia data showing "2019" as the release year). However, the Planner incorrectly concluded in Step 3 that the release year was 1991, likely due to the presence of "1991" in the film's title (which refers to the setting of the story, not the release date). This led to the false conclusion that "Dilan 1991" came out first, when in reality, "Celine: Through The Eyes Of The World" (2010) came out before "Dilan 1991" (2019). This error matches the pattern of misinterpreting historical or thematic context (the year in the title) as factual release data.
